hook.sub: 5 free ways to use these instead
hook.say: Stop buying gratitude journals. These cards are free, and here are five ways to use them. Stay for the last one.

scenes.title: Family gratitude jar
scenes.say: One. These confetti slips turn any clear jar into a family gratitude jar. Add a note each day, then read them together on Sunday.

scenes.title: Pull-a-prompt bowl
scenes.say: Two. These starry prompt slips ask easy questions, like one thing that went right today. Fold them into a bowl, pull one, and share.

scenes.title: Thanksgiving place cards
scenes.say: Three. Set one of these pumpkin cards on every plate at Thanksgiving. Guests write what they're thankful for, then read them out over pie.

scenes.title: Gratitude garland
scenes.say: Four. These folk art cards have space for three good things. Fill one in each night, clip it to twine, and watch your garland grow all month.

scenes.title: Hard-day reframe cards
scenes.say: And five, my favorite. Reframe cards walk you through a tough moment: what happened, how it felt, and one thing you're still grateful for.

end.say: They're all free. Search gratitude cards printamoo dot com.
